title: Correction note: the STATUS-V2-007 threshold-provenance row states the opposite of the field it renders
scope: Presentation correction plus one flagged protocol proposal. Nothing frozen is amended by this note.

finding_1_the_contradiction.where: experiments/STATUS-V2-007.pdf, threshold table; generated by scripts/build_status_v2_007_pdf.py lines 186-187
finding_1_the_contradiction.rendered_text: Empirically derived from NATQ-002 | True (i.e. not derived)
finding_1_the_contradiction.why_it_is_wrong: The row label asserts 'empirically derived' and the value asserts 'True', which together state the opposite of the truth. The trailing parenthetical contradicts the row it is attached to rather than repairing it. The defect is that a negated field name (not_empirically_derived_from_NATQ_002) was rendered against a positively-worded label without inverting the value.

the_underlying_field_is_correct.reads_as: It is TRUE that the floors were NOT empirically derived from NATQ-002.

authoritative_supporting_evidence.quote: These values are preregistered engineering acceptance floors, not empirically estimated performance priors.
WEAKLY GROUNDED AND FLAGGED. 0.80 and 0.65 are judgement calls, not derived from any NATQ-002 measurement, because none exists.
They are engineering qualification floors. They are not estimates of expected performance and must not be described as statistical priors.

finding_1_the_contradiction.intended_assertion: The 0.80 PASS floor and 0.65 FAIL floor are engineering qualification floors chosen by coordinator judgement before any NATQ-002 measurement of any system existed. They are not derived from NATQ-002 data, and they are not statistical priors or performance estimates.

corrected_wording.row_value: No — engineering qualification floors, set before any NATQ-002 score existed
corrected_wording.rule_for_future_builders: Render a negated field either by inverting the value under a positive label or by keeping the negative label. Never print a positive label against the raw value of a not_-prefixed field.

protocol_impact.reason: No scoring behaviour reads the rendered label. The governing preregistration and the coordinator threshold decision are unambiguous and unchanged. The floors remain 0.80 and 0.65 exactly as approved.

finding_1_the_contradiction.remediation_applied_here: None. STATUS-V2-007.pdf, STATUS-V2-007.json, the preregistrations and every hash are left byte-identical. This note is the correction of record.
finding_1_the_contradiction.remediation_proposed: If the coordinator wants the PDF itself corrected, reissue it as STATUS-V2-007-R1 with the corrected row and an eleventh build gate asserting the label/value pair is not self-contradictory. Do not regenerate STATUS-V2-007 in place — it has been delivered.

finding_2_decision_rule_gap.classification: PROPOSED_PROTOCOL_CORRECTION — NOT APPLIED, REQUIRES COORDINATOR APPROVAL

as_written.PASS: micro-MRR delta > 0 with a 95% interval excluding 0, AND case_hit@10 >= 0.80

finding_2_decision_rule_gap.the_gap: A significant REGRESSION falls through to INCONCLUSIVE. If SYSTEM-H's micro-MRR is worse than BM25 with a 95% interval excluding 0, and case_hit@10 is 0.65 or above, then PASS is false (delta is not > 0) and FAIL is false (the interval does not include 0, and the case_hit floor is met), so the run is labelled INCONCLUSIVE. A system that is decisively worse than the lexical control would not be recorded as a failure.
finding_2_decision_rule_gap.worked_example: delta = -0.06, 95% interval [-0.10, -0.02], case_hit@10 = 0.70 -> INCONCLUSIVE under the rule as written.

boundaries_are_otherwise_unambiguous.at_0_65: FAIL is < 0.65, so exactly 0.65 does not fail.
boundaries_are_otherwise_unambiguous.the_interval: 0.65 <= case_hit@10 < 0.80 with a significant positive delta is INCONCLUSIVE, stated explicitly in the preregistration.
boundaries_are_otherwise_unambiguous.reachability: With 40 validation cases, case_hit@10 moves in steps of 0.025; 0.65 = 26/40 and 0.80 = 32/40 are both exactly attainable, so neither boundary is unreachable.

finding_2_decision_rule_gap.proposed_replacement_clause: FAIL: the 95% interval includes 0, OR the 95% interval excludes 0 with a negative mean delta, OR case_hit@10 < 0.65.
finding_2_decision_rule_gap.why_it_is_proposed_and_not_applied: Editing the decision rule of an unconsumed preregistration is a protocol change. It is defensible only as an explicit coordinator ruling recorded before the first run, and it must be issued as a replacement preregistration (EVAL-NATQ2-H-002) with its own hash, not as an edit to EVAL-NATQ2-H-001. Applying it silently would destroy the property that makes the preregistration evidence.
finding_2_decision_rule_gap.consequence_if_left_as_written: The run remains valid and interpretable; a decisive regression would simply be reported as INCONCLUSIVE with the negative delta visible in the results. This is a labelling weakness, not a source of bias, and it does not by itself block the run.
